description: This file contains functions and logic for managing firmware images, their identification, validation, and upgrade procedures specific to certain platforms and devices within a firmware upgrade system. It handles image format detection, matching firmware to device models, and upgrade steps for NAND-based devices using different firmware formats such as TRX, SeamaSeal, and SafeLoader.

methods.name: get_magic_long_at
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes at a given offset from a file and returns the value as a hex string.

methods.name: get_le_long_at
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes at a given offset from a file and returns the value as a little-endian integer.

methods.name: platform_flash_type
methods.description: Determines if the platform uses serial (NAND) or NAND flash based on /proc/mtd entries.

methods.name: platform_expected_image
methods.description: Returns the expected firmware image filename based on the device model obtained from 'board_name'.

methods.name: platform_identify
methods.description: Identifies the firmware image format and extracts metadata such as board ID for a given firmware image file.

methods.name: platform_other_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image for compatibility, checks format and integrity, and reports mismatch or errors.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Main entry point to validate the firmware image for supported device models.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_nand_trx
methods.description: Handles upgrade process for NAND devices with TRX format firmware images.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_nand_seamaseal
methods.description: Handles upgrade process for NAND devices using SeamaSeal format images.

methods.name: platform_img_from_safeloader
methods.description: Extracts the firmware image from a SafeLoader formatted file.

methods.name: platform_other_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs upgrade steps based on detected image format and device type, handling different formats accordingly.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main entry point to perform the firmware upgrade process, selecting appropriate upgrade procedures based on device.
